name: The Dead Fields
summary: At the Dead Fields, Forsaken forces face a Scourge threat in northern Silverpine. High Executor Hadrec sends champions from the Sepulcher against the Rot Hide gnolls and the banshee who shields them.

sections.title: A Plague upon the Fields
sections.body: North of the Sepulcher, an abandoned farmstead lies overrun by Rot Hide gnolls. The fields once held ordinary farms, but now these plague ridden scavengers infest the Silverpine countryside. High Executor Hadrec sent small raiding parties to drive them out. Each attack stalled under a strange magical resistance.

sections.title: The Banshee's Grasp
sections.body: Nightlash, a Scourge banshee, directs the Rot Hide gnolls and scatters Forsaken skirmishers with dark sorcery when the gnolls face defeat. Hadrec sends Horde champions to cut down the gnolls and draw Nightlash into the open. He asks for her spectral essence as proof that she is destroyed.

faq.q: Where are the Dead Fields located?
faq.answer: The Dead Fields lie north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Rot Hide gnolls overrun the abandoned, decaying farmstead.
Nightlash is a Scourge banshee who commands and shields the Rot Hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. Her dark magic has driven off Forsaken assault parties.

faq.q: Why are gnolls working with a banshee?
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls of Silverpine Forest are tainted by the plague of undeath. The Scourge directs these rabid creatures as vanguard foot soldiers against the Forsaken through figures like Nightlash.

faq.q: How do you draw out Nightlash?
faq.answer: Nightlash stays hidden while the gnolls under her protection remain in force. Slay enough Rot Hides, and she appears in the field to defend her domain.

faq.q: Who gives the quest The Dead Fields?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken military commander at the Sepulcher, sends you against the Scourge threat as he seeks to secure the region.

faq.q: What happens after Nightlash is destroyed?
faq.answer: Nightlash's essence proves to High Executor Hadrec that the Scourge has lost a vital presence in northern Silverpine. He then directs you toward the Decrepit Ferry east of the Sepulcher.

angles.text: As Forsaken, destroying Nightlash strikes at the Scourge and recalls the spectral torment Sylvanas and her banshees escaped.
As Horde, breaking the Scourge's hold over northern Silverpine helps protect the travel corridor between the Undercity and Lordaeron's southern territories.
